items.text: Indianapolis traded LG Quenton Nelson to Seattle and DT DeForest Buckner this week; CB Cam Taylor-Britt and WR Alec Pierce are on IR.

Indianapolis (final report): OUT: WR Anthony Gould (concussion), CB Justin Walley (knee). QUESTIONABLE: LB Bryce Boettcher (groin, no practice all week), TE Drew Ogletree (knee). Steichen says CB Sauce Gardner (calf) and TE Tyler Warren (groin) are good to go.

Jacksonville (final report): OUT: S Antonio Johnson (ankle). QUESTIONABLE: WR Jakobi Meyers (hamstring/ankle). Josh Hines-Allen, Brenton Strange and Trevor Lawrence have no designation. LT Anton Harrison is out for the season (ACL).

adjust.reason: Indianapolis just traded Quenton Nelson and DeForest Buckner and is missing CBs Walley and Taylor-Britt and WR Pierce, against Jacksonville's losses of LT Anton Harrison and S Antonio Johnson. The stats model doesn't price non-QB injuries
